question: Which singers performed in concerts held in 2014? List each singer once.
reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT s.Name FROM singer AS s JOIN singer_in_concert AS sic ON s.Singer_ID = sic.Singer_ID JOIN concert AS c ON sic.concert_ID = c.concert_ID WHERE c.Year = '2014'
candidate_sql:
SELECT DISTINCT s.Name
FROM singer AS s
JOIN singer_in_concert AS sic
  ON sic.Singer_ID = CAST(s.Singer_ID AS VARCHAR)
JOIN concert AS c
  ON c.concert_ID = sic.concert_ID
WHERE c.Year = '2014';
